note: Owns a two-acre flower farm in Hawaii, travels internationally for hiking, and raised payment himself without a flicker of price resistance ('So you take credit card, I presume') — comfortably successful and able to pay. He is not the deconditioned gym-averse exclusion either: he is a gym member who did kettlebell classes and could do pull-ups a year ago. But he fails the two criteria that define the stated ICP's starting point. Health is not his neglected area, it is an acute medical crisis under the management of three physicians — post-C.-difficile, post-faecal-transplant, three to six months from stability. And this is rescue, not good-to-great: he has not trained since November and his own framing is getting back to where he was. He also exposes the gap already recorded against the stated ICP — there is no clinical criterion in it at all, so nothing in the written definition would have caught the single most important fact about this prospect. The rep caught it anyway, on judgement.
